701	func collectCommitsSince(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, repoPath string, tip, exclude plumbing.Hash) ([]*object.Commit, error) {

706		// replaying merge commits would incorrectly re-apply changes that arrived via

712			return nil, fmt.Errorf("git rev-list failed: %w", err)
713		}

717			return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit chain exceeded %d commits; aborting rebase", MaxCommitTraversalDepth)
718		}

720		commits := make([]*object.Commit, 0, len(lines))

723			commit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(hash)
724			if commitErr != nil {
725				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit %s: %w", hash, commitErr)
726			}
727			if len(commit.ParentHashes) > 1 {
728				continue
729			}
730			commits = append(commits, commit)

733		return commits, nil
